parts.html: A 220 m² villa in Burgas that we took from the first sketches to the finished interior: interior design project, 3D visualization, technical documentation, custom furniture and turnkey renovation. The project covered the living room, a kitchen with built-in appliances, bedrooms, walk-in closets, the entrance hall, bathrooms and storage. The same materials run through every room: gray stone, wood and graphite fronts.

The living room is on a corner, with floor-to-ceiling windows on two sides. A light L-shaped sofa sits next to a cognac leather chaise. Above the sofa hang two chandeliers with globes on copper rods, and the ceiling has an inset of white slats with lighting around the edge.

The TV wall is clad in large gray stone slabs with a horizontal pattern, and a fireplace with a glass firebox is built in below the TV. The same stone is used on the living room and kitchen floors. Along the other wall are cabinets with wood fronts and a graphite cubby shelving unit with lit shelves.

The kitchen is open to the living room. In the middle is a long gray island with a gas cooktop and a deep dark stone sink, extended by a wooden breakfast bar. The wall behind the kitchen is clad in horizontal wood panels with a hidden door. The appliances are built into a graphite column of tall cabinets with lit niches. Above the island hang two chandeliers of glowing glass tubes.

The bedroom has a light plank floor, concrete-effect panels behind the bed, lit from above, and a wide upholstered headboard. Opposite are wood panels with a hidden door and a white dressing table. The walk-in closet is separated by sliding tinted glass partitions with a vertical pattern, and inside are wooden shelves, rails and lighting.

The kitchen, cabinets, walk-in closets and shelving were made to order to fit the rooms. Before starting, we prepared the technical documentation and a detailed cost estimate: labor, materials, furniture, appliances, plumbing fixtures and lighting. Then we carried out the turnkey renovation and installed the furniture. More about the service: turnkey renovation.
